steps.note: Open the API-prepared closed RFQ event; this is the required starting state for prepared cases.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required post-expiry surrogate-bid configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-edit configuration.
Open the RFQ stage referenced by the case.
Open the RFQ Responses tab before inspecting its Settings menu.
Choose Order Activity from the RFQ stage Settings menu; the step leaves the resulting Activity drawer open.
Assert that the Activity window/drawer opened.
